speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the nature of your pain: does it feel like an electric shock or burning, and does it extend below your knee? Also, have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: That radiation into the foot is concerning for nerve root involvement; has this pain worsened with coughing or sneezing, and do you have any loss of bowel or bladder control? Also, have you noticed any visible weakness in lifting your foot against gravity?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sharp lower back pain radiating to the leg and foot. I also have Pain worsens with movement, The onset of pain while exercising.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: MRI Lumbar Spine to evaluate for a herniated disc compressing the nerve root.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L4 or L5 radiculopathy)
